consequence.statement: This is a new convenience feature that simplifies keystore password configuration by allowing literal string values in the Certificate resource; existing configurations using passwordSecretRef continue to work unchanged.

assertion.statement: A new password field is added to PKCS#12 and JKS keystores in the Certificate resource, allowing passwords to be specified as literal strings, mutually exclusive with the existing passwordSecretRef field.
